messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: spike in 5xx rate for service: frontend-gateway (prod) — alert: gateway_5xx_rate_high — threshold breached 3m ago. current 5xx rate: 18% (baseline 0.8%) — routing group: edge-us-east-1. Pager: @ben (oncall)
ben (oncall): I’m on it. joining bridge 10.1.2.3/meet. can someone post top-level symptoms?
eva (support): multiple customers reporting timeouts & 502s from API endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream. first reports ~08:23 UTC.
alice (sre): seeing surge of upstream 503s in envoy logs. sample: 
```
[2026-03-02T08:24:12Z] envoy [warning] upstream reset: reset reason=connection failure, 503 from upstream target pool
[2026-03-02T08:24:13Z] envoy [error] HTTP response code: 503, route: /v1/generate, host: model-pool-A
```

alice (sre): metrics: 5xx % by route: /v1/generate 22%, /v1/chat/stream 15% for last 5m. p50 latency up ~1.2s. p95 spiking to 8-12s.
ben (oncall): suspects: retry amplification loop or new LB config rollout. anyone recently touched envoy route/retry config?
dinesh (prod-eng): we rolled a global retry policy change in edge config ~07:55 to increase `max_retries` from 1 -> 3 to reduce client-visible flakiness.
ben (oncall): that fits. retries can amplify load and trip circuit breakers -> more 5xx. check envoy config for route-level retry vs global.
carmen (infra): pulling current config from control-plane: 
```
route:
  name: v1-generate-route
  match: /v1/generate
  retry_policy:
    retry_on: 5xx,connect,gateway-error,refused-stream
    num_retries: 3
    per_try_timeout: 2s
  route_action:
    cluster: model-pool-A
    max_retries_before_redirect: 0

circuit_breakers:
  thresholds:
    priority: default
    max_connections: 200
    max_pending_requests: 150
    max_requests: 300
    max_retries: 1
```

alice (sre): I see num_retries: 3 and per_try_timeout 2s — that will multiply load. Also circuit_breaker max_requests 300 seems low given increased concurrency.
ben (oncall): quick mitigation: reduce num_retries to 0/1 and increase circuit breaker request threshold and pending. anyone able to patch config?
dinesh (prod-eng): I can rollback the retry change to 1 immediately. Carmen, can you increase `max_pending_requests` to 800 and `max_requests` to 1200 as temporary?
carmen (infra): applying change to control-plane now. will push to edge-us-east-1 first then regionally.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: rolling config change started for edge-us-east-1 (change id cfg-20260302-0810).
ben (oncall): while that rolls, can we throttle client retries at LB layer? maybe lower frontend timeout to avoid retry storms.
alice (sre): also temporarily disable retry_on: `gateway-error` and `refused-stream`. that reduces aggressive retrying for transient gateway errors.
dinesh (prod-eng): patch ready: set `num_retries: 1`, `retry_on: 5xx,connect` and bump circuit_breakers thresholds as Carmen said. pushing now.
carmen (infra): config push completed for edge-us-east-1 at 08:32 UTC. rollouts to other regions in progress. health checks green for control-plane.
ben (oncall): metrics update?
alice (sre): 2m after change: 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 7.2%. p95 latency down to 4s. good direction.
frank (customer-ops): flagged priority customer A (acct-412) — they confirmed degraded experience but are taking feedback. will notify them that mitigation is in progress.
eva (support): opened ticket TKT-7891 for impacted customers and added status note to dashboard.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: config rollout to edge-us-west-2 started (cfg-20260302-0813).
ben (oncall): keep rolling. prioritize regions with highest traffic first (us-east, us-west). Carmen, estimate full global rollout?
carmen (infra): estimated 15 minutes across regions.
alice (sre): also seeing increased 502s where envoy upstream truncated connections: logs: 
```
[2026-03-02T08:27:03Z] envoy [warning] upstream premature response end: bytes_sent=0, reset_reason=connect_failure
```

alice (sre): that points to model-pool nodes getting overloaded and closing connections — check pool autoscaling and connection backlog.
dinesh (prod-eng): model-pool-A autoscaler did not trigger fast enough; I’m increasing target replicas and lowering scale-up cooldown.
ben (oncall): please do that and watch error rates.
dinesh (prod-eng): scaling now: target_replicas 18 -> 40 for pool-A. launching.
ben (oncall): anyone seeing any config rollbacks interfering?
carmen (infra): no rollbacks. control-plane shows successful snapshots.
alice (sre): 8m after the combined mitigation (retry reduction + cb bump + scale up): global 5xx rate now 1.1% — back near baseline. p95 latency ~900ms.
frank (customer-ops): notified affected customers about mitigation and ETA for RCA. they appreciate quick update.
eva (support): updating status page: "Partial service degradation for generation endpoints — mitigated, under observation."
ben (oncall): handing off to Alice for post-incident monitoring and RCA. I’ll stay available for escalation. taking TODOs: timeline and timeline notes.
ben (oncall): oncall handoff -> alice (sre) at 08:45 UTC.
alice (sre): taking post-incident. will collect logs, config diffs, and draft RCA. immediate action items: 1) revert global retry policy change and add canary rollout guard, 2) increase default circuit breaker thresholds or make them autoscale-aware, 3) adjust autoscaler sensitivity for model pools, 4) add alert for retry amplification (retries per request > threshold).
dinesh (prod-eng): will prepare a safer rollout path for retry policy changes (canary + traffic cap).
carmen (infra): I’ll add an automated check in CI that verifies retry vs cb thresholds before deployment.
eva (support): I'll follow up with customers and close TKT-7891 after RCA draft.
incident-bot: incident-summary: incident_id=20260302-01, severity=high, duration=~22m, impact=partial degradation of generation endpoints, mitigations applied=reduced retries, raised circuit breakers, scaled model-pool, status=mitigated, owner=alice (sre).
alice (sre): creating postmortem doc and will ping the channel when ready. thanks everyone for fast responses :heart:
frank (customer-ops): please include suggested customer communication for impacted enterprise accounts.
alice (sre): will do. arch notes: need formal guidance on safe retry policy rollouts and better observability around per-request retry counts.
ben (oncall): closing active pager but leaving thread open for RCA. good job team. :thumbsup:
